title: synoreclaim config init result v1
description: `config init`: writes the default cleanup configuration unless a trusted one exists (SPEC 5.7); or a refusal.

enables_cleanup.description: cleanup_enabled and not mutations_disabled: cleanup plan, apply and delete may run.

created.description: True when this call wrote the file; false when a trusted one was kept as is.

anyOf.description: A refusal or failure: errors[0].code says why (SPEC 5.7).

config.description: The package's config.json (package user's, in /var/packages/SynoReclaim/etc) as written.

mutations_disabled.description: True turns every cleanup mutation off.

allowed_roots.description: Absent: any root. Cleanup targets must lie below one of these absolute paths.
